title: Attr.autofocus is a silent no-op on the mount frame under Expert.embed (no GtkRoot at fixup time)
description: task-2-review Important 1: gtk_widget_grab_focus returns FALSE when root is NULL (gtkwidget.c:5158-61 @ 4.22.4); fire-once never retries; the headless handle certifies such trees. mli documents the limitation (task 2 fix round). Real fix candidates: retry the grab on the widget's map signal or notify::root one-shot, still honouring once-per-frame-per-toplevel; or an embed-level deferred fixup once the wrapper is rooted. Matters for embedded pages that want an entry focused without being toplevels.

title: Real-input tests via XTEST/xdotool under Xvfb to close the synthetic click/key gap
description: M2 shipped click/key controllers with plumbing-only live tests because the binding has no way to synthesise a GdkEvent (pre-flight correction 1). An xdotool/XTEST-driven live test (Xvfb, presented window, xdotool click/key at the widget's allocation) would exercise GTK's real routing end to end — the only change that closes the gap rather than compensating for it (gallery Input page, Task 16 click-through). From task-13-review.md's re-review.
